remarks_1999: VII in title written in by Doris Bry in black ink in Abiquiú Notebooks. Whitney Archive record lost. Abiquiú Notebooks notes backing inscription 1. Part of series renumbered by O'Keeffe and Doris Bry in 1970. O'Keeffe wrote: "After painting the shell and shingle many times, I did a misty landscape of the mountain across the lake, and the mountain became the shape of the shingle"(*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 52). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
